data.cultural_impact: In Indian culture, the name Ramila holds a deep connection with the popular Hindu epic, Ramayana. Ramila refers to the beloved wife of Lord Rama, Sita, who is revered for her unwavering devotion and loyalty to her husband. The name Ramila is thus a reminder of the ideal relationship between a husband and wife, rooted in love, trust, and selflessness.
